$comment: Read by ~/.claude/hooks/harness-gate.py. `staging`: finished work merges there; nothing but `release` reaches main (no PR, merge or push into main). `paths`: a release whose staging touches them needs a passing gate verdict for staging's tree in <main checkout>/.harness/verdicts/ (harness/release.ts runs the gate when there is none).
cost: about 8 minutes on a laptop; the first run on a machine also measures origin/main
